entities.summary:
Ko Pha-ngan is an island in the Gulf of Thailand in Surat Thani Province of southern Thailand. Ko Pha-ngan has two sister islands: the larger Ko Samui to the south and the smaller Ko Tao to the north.Estimated perimeter: 40 km (25 mi) 
From mainland: about 55 km (34 mi)
From Ko Samui: about 15 km (9.3 mi)
From Ko Tao: about 35 km (22 mi)
Main town: Thong Sala
Highest Point: Khao Ra, 635 m (2,083 ft)
